items.check: every number in a report is generated by build_r54_contract.py from RESULTS/*.json
items.fail_action: delete the hand-typed number and rebuild

items.check: sha256 of every input equals the value recorded in the result provenance
every carrier names frame, epoch type and units; mixed frames only through a declared transport
every tail probability names its law; no sigma conversion unless the law is exactly Gaussian or chi-square
claim tier C0; none of conventions.forbidden_phrases_in_reports appears
no download, no PR4 simulation, no native Bianchi solver, no new science node
citations: only evidence rows marked VERIFIED are stated as fact; others carry their status
items.fail_action: verify from the primary source or mark

items.check: edits stay inside the node file allowlist of RESEARCH_DAG.json
acceptance failed twice: a BLOCKER note is written and thresholds are untouched
analysis choices equal the contract; deviations are listed in DEVIATIONS.json before outputs are read

plausibility ranges: sd(Sigma_T) in [5e-6, 2e-5]; sd(Sigma_E) in [3e-8, 3e-7]; LCDM bulk sd per axis in [50, 200] km/s; r_E(perfect fluid) in [0.070, 0.072]; linear sigma_v,1D in [290, 330] km/s; exact/ideal body sd ratio in [0.8, 2.5]; apparent H of the log estimator in [70, 80] km/s/Mpc
items.fail_action: treat as a bug, not as a result

items.check: mutation gates of the node were run and each named test failed under its mutation
negative and null results are written to state/NEGATIVE_RESULTS.md through the builder
every analysis choice made after looking at data is listed in the forking-path register of THEORY_LOOPS.md and its tail is reported with the scan or variant correction
items.fail_action: add the entry or remove the statement

items.check: a decision that depends on a nuisance model is reported per model; no single class is quoted when the models disagree
items.fail_action: replace the class by the table

run: before every commit and at node close; answer each item with PASS, FAIL or N/A plus the file and key that proves it
